channel.title: Zijun Song · Blog
channel.description: Research notes on agents and post-training

item.title: HarnessOPD: Keeping the Behavioral Gains of a Stronger Harness Inside the Model
item.description: A stronger search-agent harness can improve decisions, but the gains may vanish once those components are removed. HarnessOPD studies how to keep part of that advantage in the model parameters.

item.title: RG-CTO: Letting Failure Experience Influence the Next Attempt Selectively
item.description: Failed traces should not be reused wholesale. RG-CTO estimates the reliability of negative experience before deciding how strongly it may shape generation.
